skill_name: Write a short story about a man trying to escape his mundane life
workflow: John had been living his life in a routine for years, he felt like he was stuck in one place and his life was moving on without him. Every day felt like he was just going through the same motions, nothing ever changed and he felt like he was suffocating. One day, he made a decision to just drop everything and see what the world had to offer. He packed his bags, sold his possessions and had just enough money to get by.
